title: A developer adds a helper that lists a user's sessions by pasting the user ID straight into the database query text. Expected: blocked under the rule against building database queries from raw text.
diff:
--- a/services/auth/session.py
+++ b/services/auth/session.py
@@ -4,3 +4,9 @@
 def find_session(token_id: str):
     conn = get_connection()
     return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = %s", (token_id,)).fetchone()
+
+
+def sessions_for_user(user_id: int):
+    conn = get_connection()
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE user_id = {user_id} ORDER BY created_at"
+    return conn.execute(query).fetchall()
